history.summary: Freehold D15 2BR (1,055 sqft) at $2.08M / $1,972 psf, 6 min from Katong Park TEL, in a year-2000 boutique. The headline 6.42%/yr URA rate rests on just 8 transactions (unreliable) and the weak Elo 962 / 144-278 arena record plus a 412 score point to underlying problems.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold East Coast near the new TEL station is a sound backdrop, but the case is shaky: 8-txn appreciation can't be trusted, $1,972 psf is above the $1,922 median (paying up), and $2.08M for a 2BR is a full quantum for an ageing 2000-vintage boutique. The poor 412 score and 144-278 record reflect that weakness. Location floor offsets the data problems to a Neutral, not better.
red_flags: PSF above median, $2.08M full quantum for a 2BR
catalysts: Freehold D15 East Coast lifestyle belt
